subject.title: fix(anthropic): keep OAuth callback on loopback

question: Should Anthropic OAuth reject non-loopback OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST values while keeping the provider-visible redirect URI fixed at http://localhost:53692/callback?
rationale: This changes an auth-provider environment surface from permissive to fail-closed and relies on a provider redirect contract that the tests mock at token exchange time.

options.title: Accept After Proof
options.body: Require redacted current-head CLI/login proof for invalid-host rejection and at least one allowed loopback callback path, then accept the fixed-localhost redirect contract.

options.title: Require Stronger Provider Evidence
options.body: Ask for live Anthropic or installed-client evidence that localhost is the registered redirect URI for the supported loopback binds before merge.

options.title: Pause For Auth Redesign
options.body: Pause this PR if the desired direction is to remove or redesign the callback-host override instead of hardening it narrowly.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted current-head CLI/login proof for invalid-host rejection and at least one allowed loopback callback path, then accept the fixed-localhost redirect contract.
